glosses: step; footstep; pace (movement made from one foot to the other)
step; pace (a unit distance roughly equivalent to the distance covered in a step)
step; footstep (sound produced by stepping on the ground)

examples.text: Eu o vi na noite passada.

examples.en: I was very busy last week.

examples.text: Você esteve aqui na semana passada?
